title: TradeGuard Risk Rules Configuration
description: User-defined thresholds for trade validation rules

maxLeverage.description: Maximum leverage multiplier for futures trades (e.g., 5 = 5x)

maxOrderSizeUSDT.description: Maximum notional order size in USDT

maxPriceDeviationPct.description: Maximum allowed deviation between proposed price and live market price, as a percentage (e.g., 2.0 = 2%)

allowedSymbols.description: Whitelist of trading pairs the agent is allowed to trade

symbolSpecificDeviations.description: Optional per-symbol price deviation thresholds (overrides maxPriceDeviationPct for specific symbols)
